objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed object whose properties, content, versions, validity, release, distribution, translation and archiving are described.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document object.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Composed by default from abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is retained per released version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in the document life cycle and workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and workflow participant assignment.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used for additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and review participant assignment.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and release participant assignment, including translation.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons for email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons for distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with Valid From to calculate Valid Until.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents remain before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version whose Released state is required before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which the released language version is visible to authorized readers.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special detailed work steps usually relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user of the system who may be assigned roles, tasks, authorizations, or distribution.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned personal authorizations or included in distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users/persons used for authorizations, reader assignment, distribution and roles.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to provide read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented to provide users with functions according to their area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: System role whose users can view approved objects.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in author or co-author selection lists and can create specified objects.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in reviewer selection lists and check document content.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in releaser selection lists and decide whether a document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: System role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created without affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request linked to the document to be checked when validity expiration approaches.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for reactivation of an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested and documented for distribution for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in the report listing acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups in distribution lists.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria filtering result lists according to settings.

attributes.name: traffic_light
attributes.description: Traffic light display used in status reports.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard list of all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Object evaluated with documents in status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a document checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents can be linked, for example IT applications.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents can be linked.
